text:
Ava (People Ops): quick follow-up from the all-hands — can someone confirm the mid-year review cutoff and manager calibration window? also curious how off-cycle raises / missed promo cycles get handled. thanks! :wave:

Jordan (Head of People Ops): great question — thanks for surfacing. short answers below, fuller doc linked. will host office hours tomorrow at 4pm PT for any edge cases. :calendar:

Samir (Eng Manager): tl;dr dates pls — want to sync w/ my 1:1s.

Priya (People Ops): cutoff for mid-year self-reviews is 2026-06-05 EOD PT. manager calibration window is 2026-06-12 -> 2026-06-19. those are the windows we commit to for comp+promo decisions.

Nia (People Ops Lead): off-cycle raises and mid-cycle promo nominations are allowed but require manager + EM approval and a short rationale. aim is to keep them for exceptional cases only (org change, retention risk, ownership change).

Samir (Eng Manager): what's the mechanism? form? thread?

Priya (People Ops): please use the internal form: https://intra.redwood.company/forms/promo-nom. two required fields: business justification (2-3 bullets) and manager impact statement. the form auto-notifies People Ops. if urgent, ping me after submission.

Ava (People Ops): if someone missed the cycle entirely (e.g., new hire in probation) — can they be considered?

Jordan (Head of People Ops): yes, there are three paths: 1) standard cycle (preferred), 2) off-cycle promo via form + EM + People Ops signoff (for clear scope/jump), 3) retroactive correction for admin errors (handled by People Ops + Payroll). retro pay will be processed on the next payroll run after approval — expect a 1-2 paycycle lag.

Samir (Eng Manager): are there any hard limits on off-cycle promos? budget guardrails?

Nia (People Ops Lead): we do require EM + Director signoff for off-cycle promotions that exceed role-band midpoint. People Ops will flag budgetary constraints during calibration. aim to keep off-cycle <5% of headcount in any org to preserve fairness.

Priya (People Ops): appeals: if a manager believes a case was overlooked during calibration, submit the promo-nom form and add the calibration timestamp + name of reviewer. People Ops will triage within 5 business days. :eyes:

Samir (Eng Manager): and comp increase approvals? any difference from promo approvals?

Jordan (Head of People Ops): comp increases follow a similar flow; small merit adjustments (<5% of base) often handled in manager+HR lane; >5% require Director + People Ops + Finance approval. we try to separate comp approval from title change but both can be done together.

Ava (People Ops): can we get a short FAQ or template for manager justification to share with new managers?

Priya (People Ops): yep — here's a quick template (drop into the form or copy into your notes):

```
Candidate: <name>\nCurrent role/title: <role>\nProposed role/title: <role>\nBusiness rationale (3 bullets):\n - impact/metrics\n - new scope / leadership shown\n - retention / market signal\nManager impact statement: <2-3 sentences>\nRequested comp band (optional): <band/midpoint>%\n\nApprovals: Manager / Director / People Ops
```

Nia (People Ops Lead): recording of the all-hands Q&A, the detailed timeline, and the form live link will be posted in #people-ops-resources after this thread. office hours tomorrow 4pm PT — please bring specific cases, we'll do breakout slots. :white_check_mark:

PayrollBot: Reminder scheduled — "Office hours: people-ops calibration Q&A" tomorrow 2026-05-18 16:00 PT.

Samir (Eng Manager): thanks — appreciate the clarity. i'll surface to my leads and prep nominations where needed.

Jordan (Head of People Ops): thanks everyone. if you have a particularly sensitive case, DM me or Nia directly so we can prioritize. :pray:
